scope: Study coverage, not an accuracy score or universal certification.

categories.v2_and_legacy: Mixed generation of clearly labelled audit evidence

capabilities.capability: Report findings → facts → methods → proof → verdict
capabilities.establishes: Executed audits with inferred criteria, source mappings, separate argument items and actual target checks.
capabilities.limits: Synthetic record; source authenticity and arbitrary future interpretations are not certified.

capabilities.capability: Correct conclusion with a refuted offered premise
capabilities.establishes: The conclusion stays supported while the argument is unsound; exact counterevidence is explained.
capabilities.limits: False premise and invalid inference are different defects; the latter is not inferred merely from the former.

capabilities.establishes: Bounded searches and auxiliary countermodels; independently correct conclusions can still lack author support.
capabilities.limits: Failure to find a proof alone is not non-entailment, and non-entailment is not proof of the event’s negation.

capabilities.capability: Agent tools and Lean without Python audit gates
capabilities.establishes: Actual Lean execution, exact targets, axiom reports and separate review in both report variants.
capabilities.limits: Metadata checks are agent-reviewed; no Python-v2 or Lake success is claimed.

capabilities.capability: Copied skill, HTML import and reviewed local modules
capabilities.establishes: Audits run from a copied skill; a non-native format enters through original-bound, reviewed extraction; nested modules are rebuilt.
capabilities.limits: This validates the shown HTML route, not every file format or every installed Lean library.

capabilities.capability: DOCX/PDF/OCR with a real transcription correction
capabilities.establishes: Original formats, actual OCR, visual inspection, attributed correction and retained raw extraction.
capabilities.limits: The scan remains partial with explicit acknowledgement; broad handwriting or multilingual OCR accuracy is not measured.

capabilities.capability: Source revision, dependency invalidation and changed verdict
capabilities.establishes: Corrected C20→C45 flips total120 from supported to refuted; all technical results rechecked; original history retained.
capabilities.limits: Narrow semantic dependencies are declared and reviewed; unchanged semantic verdicts still require technical checks.

capabilities.capability: Bounded extraction, resumption and partial acknowledgement
capabilities.establishes: A finite document batch really stops and resumes without pretending the partial scan is fully certain.
capabilities.limits: Batch completion is not exhaustive semantic interpretation.

capabilities.establishes: Concrete unique-minute unions plus generic half-open touching and empty-interval Lean theorems.
capabilities.limits: Partial clipping of an interval crossing a window boundary is not instantiated; no general union-cardinality theorem is claimed.

capabilities.capability: Exact positive/negative half-cent ties and rounding order
capabilities.establishes: A supplied away-from-zero policy is executed with exact signed integers, without floating-point approximation.
capabilities.limits: This is one explicit policy, not a claim that all accounting systems use the same rule.

capabilities.capability: General quantified propositions beyond finite fixture arithmetic
capabilities.establishes: Touching_union and empty_interval are quantified over arbitrary natural-number offsets; concrete targets are separate.
capabilities.limits: No general statistical or causal inference framework is validated by those propositions.

capabilities.capability: Missing operational criteria and honest abstention
capabilities.establishes: No invented rubric; documentary statements that criteria are missing can be supported.
capabilities.limits: Absence of a rubric does not establish that the qualitative judgment is false.

capabilities.establishes: Sources remain separately attributed; the report’s certainty can fail while the underlying event stays unresolved.
capabilities.limits: Historical v1 audits do not acquire v2 guarantees by publication or proof replay.

capabilities.capability: Temporal/version rules, exceptions and narrative testimony
capabilities.establishes: Executed source-linked examples of these semantic problems, clearly labelled legacy.
capabilities.limits: These are historical demonstrations, not fresh validations of every latest helper control.

capabilities.capability: Integrity gates, malformed inputs and dependency propagation
capabilities.establishes: Technical rejection tests include changed quotes/targets, unapproved axioms, imported-source review and transitive claim dependencies.
capabilities.limits: A passed implementation test is not a new independently audited dossier.

capabilities.capability: Disk-backed indexing and resumption at larger input counts
capabilities.establishes: Executed ingestion/retrieval scale check and a separate multi-document synthetic audit.
capabilities.limits: The1002-document run does not measure large-corpus semantic accuracy.

capabilities.establishes: Policy binding and wrong-version rejection tested; current real executions use4.24.0.
capabilities.limits: A successful alternate Lean release is not demonstrated.

capabilities.capability: Real-document reliability, cryptographic authenticity and broad OCR
capabilities.establishes: These limits are exposed rather than assigned fabricated execution results.
capabilities.limits: No representative blind real-dossier benchmark, source-signature authentication, statistical calibration or broad handwriting/multilingual scan benchmark is supplied.
